scientific_intent.scientific_task: Demonstrate CPU/GPU system-wide atomic access to the same shared migratable Int32 state.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Concurrent repeated add/exchange/max/min/CAS/AND/OR/XOR reductions over disjoint GPU and CPU participant IDs, plus two untouched fields.
accuracy_requirements: Two nondeterministic exchange/CAS fields checked against original native membership predicates; retain10fullraw values rather than pretending bit-identical outputs.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Concurrency and memory-system runtime primitive; no domain-science prediction or numerical application validation.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Final-state properties do not prove linearizability, actual temporal overlap or every atomic instruction executed.
scientific_intent.classification_note: Existing broad hardware/data-movement family; explicit computer-systems/concurrency subdomain retained. Not a new single-benchmark broad family.
